cohort: 100 twin pregnancies at a tertiary center between 2018 and 2019
finding: The proportion of vaginal birth and LSCS, as well as associated maternal and neonatal outcomes, did not differ significantly between twin pregnancies of different gestational ages.
mod_finding: The data provide reassurance to practitioners to perform vaginal delivery in preterm twins.
gest_age: Early preterm (28-31 weeks), late preterm (32-35 weeks), near-term (≥36 weeks)
